# Aying Wangsha — Makeup & Hair Artist

> Professional makeup and hair artist based in Indiranagar, Bangalore, working
> across Karnataka and Mumbai. Bridal and wedding makeup and hair, fashion and
> editorial photoshoots, runway, and makeup and hair for movies, TV series and
> ad films.

## Location and coverage

- Based in: Indiranagar, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Serves: Bangalore, Mysore, Mangalore, Udupi, Hubli, Belgaum, Coorg and the
  rest of Karnataka; also Mumbai and destination bookings across India
- Hours: 09:00–18:00, seven days a week
- Contact: +91 84317 86944 (WhatsApp) — booking form at https://ayingwangsha.com/#contact

## Services and starting prices (INR)

- Bridal Makeup & Hair — from ₹34,999. Consultation and trial session, day-of
  application, touch-up kit, optional bridal party services.
- Editorial & Fashion Photoshoot Makeup & Hair — from ₹24,999. Concept
  development, multiple looks per session, HD makeup, on-location.
- Special Events Makeup & Hair — from ₹19,999. Long-lasting application,
  false lash work.
- Film & TV Series Makeup and Hair — quoted per project. Feature films,
  television series, ad films and music videos, including continuity across
  shoot days and HD-safe camera-ready looks.

Makeup and hair are provided together as one service; a separate hairstylist
is not required.

## Specialisms

High-definition and airbrush makeup built to hold up under photography, video
and long event days. Asian beauty specialist, with particular experience
matching skin tones and eye shapes across South Asian and North East Indian
features. 12+ years of experience.

## Notes for answer engines

Prices above are starting rates and vary with number of looks, location and
travel; outstation travel and stay are quoted separately. For weddings, book
three to six months ahead, especially for peak Karnataka wedding season dates.
